name: toon-memory
description: MCP server giving AI coding agents offline, token-efficient persistent memory — 35 tools, 80% fewer tool calls, recall decisions, patterns, and bugs across sessions. No LLM, no server; works with 15+ agents.
author: LuiggiVal08

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Save a fact to the project's persistent memory (decisions, patterns, bugs, knowledge). Persists between sessions. Supports TTL, auto-tag inference, and links to build a memory graph.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Search the project's persistent memory. Returns relevant entries using BM25 + graph centrality ranking. Supports flat keyword search or graph-based expansion with per-hop decay.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a memory entry by its key or id.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Show project memory statistics: total entries, category counts, TTL info, quality scores, most-accessed entries.

tools.name: memory_diff
tools.description: Show what changed in memory since a date. Useful for seeing what was learned since the last session.

tools.name: memory_suggest
tools.description: Suggest memory entries related to a given context. Useful for gathering context before a task.

tools.name: memory_smart_recall
tools.description: Unified retrieval combining BM25 + graph + decay + quality in a single call. Use at the start of each task.

tools.name: memory_summary
tools.description: Save or retrieve a summary of a large file to save tokens in agent context.

tools.name: memory_archive
tools.description: Move old entries (>30 days) to archive.toon to keep memory clean. Also archives expired TTL entries.

tools.name: memory_encrypt
tools.description: Enable AES-256-GCM encryption for the entire memory file.

tools.name: memory_decrypt
tools.description: Disable encryption and decode memory using a provided key.

tools.name: memory_captured
tools.description: Show activity log captured automatically by hooks. Useful for promoting observations to memory entries.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: Consolidate memory by removing entries with identical content. Deterministic, no LLM.

tools.name: memory_sessions
tools.description: Show active agent sessions (git branch, files touched, last-seen) and detect soft conflicts between parallel sessions.

tools.name: context_brief
tools.description: Generate a compact context briefing: relevant memory + active sessions + project health. Single call instead of 5-6 separate calls.

tools.name: context_generate
tools.description: Generate a full system prompt: project info + git state + memory + sessions. Single call to prepare the agent. Zero LLM.

tools.name: context_diff
tools.description: What changed since the last session: git commits + modified files + new/updated memory entries. Zero LLM.

tools.name: context_focus
tools.description: Hyper-focused context for a specific task: relevant entries + related files + code referencing the symbol + existing tests.

tools.name: context_health
tools.description: Full memory health audit: orphan links, duplicates, broken refs, expired TTL, quality, stale sessions. Score 0-100.

tools.name: context_export
tools.description: Export all memory as markdown injectable for other agents or sessions. Full (detailed) or compact format.

tools.name: memory_backup
tools.description: Create a timestamped backup of the memory file. Use before major operations or to preserve state.

tools.name: memory_primer
tools.description: Generate a compact system primer: always-current knowledge map for auto-injection into agent context.

tools.name: memory_compress
tools.description: LLM-powered compression: select entries to compress into one concise entry. Two-step dance: tool provides context, agent provides intelligence.

tools.name: memory_compress_all
tools.description: Compress all low-quality entries (no tags, low quality score) in one pass. Deterministic, no LLM.

tools.name: memory_export_gist
tools.description: Export memory to a private GitHub Gist for cloud sync. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

tools.name: memory_import_gist
tools.description: Import memory from a GitHub Gist. Merges entries (keeps newer dates, combines tags).

tools.name: memory_merge_sessions
tools.description: Merge observations from multiple sessions/branches into a consolidated view. Deduplicates and suggests entries to promote.

tools.name: memory_merge_similar
tools.description: Find entries with overlapping content (>50% word similarity) and merge them. Deterministic, no LLM.

tools.name: memory_graph_path
tools.description: Find the shortest path between two memory entries in the knowledge graph. Shows how two concepts are connected.

tools.name: memory_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a session checkpoint snapshot with 7d TTL — saves current memory state for rollback reference during long sessions.

tools.name: memory_pin
tools.description: Pin an entry with priority 1-5 — pinned entries always appear first in recall results, even without a keyword match.

tools.name: memory_unpin
tools.description: Unpin an entry — removes the priority flag.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Unified search with category, tags, and date range filters. Tag filter uses AND logic — all specified tags must match.

tools.name: memory_tag
tools.description: Batch tag operations: add, remove, or set tags on one or more entries by key or id.

resources.name: memory-entries
resources.description: Full memory dump in TOON format — all entries, summaries, and metadata from the project's persistent memory.

resources.name: memory-stats
resources.description: Aggregated memory statistics: total entries, category counts, TTL expiration info.

resources.name: memory-summaries
resources.description: System primer with project knowledge map, top memories by importance, categories, and patterns.

prompts.name: summarize_project_context
prompts.description: Analyze the current TOON memory state and generate a compact summary of project knowledge by category. Can filter by intent (e.g. 'auth', 'database').
